title: README's lore check --json example shows a check.report shape that does not exist
description: Found by the reviewer pass on LCLI-571, 2026-09-25, and not re-run by this session. README.md's 'lore check --json' example shows schemaVersion as the string "1" and data keys ok/drift/brokenLinks/portability. The real output after the quickstart is {"schemaVersion":1,"kind":"check.report","data":{"findings":[],"errorCount":0,...}}. The README ships in the npm tarball. LCLI-571's quickstart gate covers the commands between the markers, not the example outputs below them.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The README check.report example matches real lore check --json output for the quickstart repository, verified by running it
